\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 165-167 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R170-first-pass-words-from-chapters-165-167}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item leather, metal, a brick, a sack, a thread
  \item a connection; a phone call, the return, arrival, departure; a match, a destination; fate
  \item a trolley, a basket, a list, a brand, quality
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Leather? (\textbf{o couro}.) Metal? (\textbf{o metal}.) A brick? (\textbf{o tijolo}.) A sack? (\textbf{o saco}.) A thread? (\textbf{o fio}.) A connection; a phone call? (\textbf{a ligação}.) The return? (\textbf{o regresso}.) Arrival? (\textbf{a chegada}.) Departure; a match? (\textbf{a partida}.) A destination; fate? (\textbf{o destino}.) A trolley? (\textbf{o carrinho}.) A basket? (\textbf{o cesto}.) A list? (\textbf{a lista}.) A brand? (\textbf{a marca}.) Quality? (\textbf{a qualidade}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
